faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a1: No. iFan runs in your web browser on any computer or phone. Create an account and you're in — no IT team required.
faq.eq1: Getting started = open your browser and you're in — nothing to install.
faq.q2: Does iFan use personal Zalo or Zalo OA?
faq.a2: iFan uses official Zalo OA only, connected through Zalo’s official API — safe, policy-compliant, never touching personal Zalo accounts. During early access, OA connection is being rolled out gradually to each customer.
faq.eq2: Zalo connection = official Zalo OA only — personal Zalo is never touched.
faq.a3: Each business gets a fully isolated workspace with regular backups. Your customer data belongs to you and is never shared.
faq.eq3: Your customer data = yours alone, fully isolated, never shared.
faq.q4: What if I want to cancel?
faq.a4: Cancel anytime — no contracts, no lock-in. Stop using iFan and you stop paying.
faq.eq4: Canceling = stop using, stop paying — no strings attached.
faq.a5: Yes. The interface ships in Vietnamese and English — switch instantly in-app. More languages are on the roadmap.
faq.eq5: Languages = Vietnamese and English built in — switch instantly in-app.

sources.title: Which source brings the money

first.label: First touch
first.explain: Gives the full revenue to the FIRST source that brought the contact in.

last.label: Last touch
last.explain: Gives the full revenue to the source on the contact when the deal was won.

linear.label: Split evenly
linear.explain: Splits the revenue evenly across EVERY source that touched the contact.

footnote.definitions: Revenue counts deals won inside the selected window, with day boundaries in Vietnam time. New contacts are counted against the first source that brought them in. Conversion = won deals ÷ new contacts FROM THAT SAME SOURCE inside the selected window — this is not the “Close rate” on the Overview (won ÷ closed). A source with no new contacts in the window shows “—” because there is no denominator, even when it still produced revenue from earlier contacts.
footnote.linearDeals: With the even split, a deal touching several sources is counted under each of them, so the Won deals column can total more than the real number of deals.

tiers.title: Customer tiers
tiers.description: Every customer is sorted into one of four tiers automatically, updated the moment they buy again or message you. Just adjust the numbers below to fit your shop.
tiers.howItWorks: When a customer changes tier the system tells Automations, so you can set up what happens next — for example, remind staff to call anyone who slips to Dormant.
tiers.count: {n, plural, one {# customer in this tier} other {# customers in this tier}}
tiers.countEmpty: No customers in this tier yet

newTier.rule: Has not bought yet, or bought fewer times than Regular requires. Nothing to set here.

regular.rule: Customers who came back and bought again.

vip.rule: Your best customers. Meeting EITHER condition below makes them VIP.

dormant.rule: Quiet for a long time — call them before you lose them.
dormant.why: Counted from their last message, call or note. If they never made contact, it counts from the day they were added. Dormant is checked before the other tiers: even a VIP who has gone quiet for too long turns Dormant, because that is who needs a call first.

errors.order: The VIP purchase count must be greater than or equal to Regular's.

card.description: A chat box right on your own website. No platform approval needed — paste one snippet and it works.

settings.title: Website chat box
settings.description: Visitors on your website tap the chat box and write — messages land straight in your iFan Inbox, and you reply like any other channel.

greeting.description: The first line a visitor sees when opening the chat box.

snippet.title: Snippet to paste on your website
snippet.description: Hand this to your web person, or paste it yourself in 4 steps.
snippet.locked: Press Save settings above and the snippet will appear right here.
snippet.how1: Press the Copy snippet button above.
snippet.how2: Open your website admin (WordPress, Haravan, Sapo, Wix… all have this).
snippet.how3: Find the box called “Insert code before </body>”, “Custom code”, “Footer script” or “Tracking code”, paste the snippet in and save.
snippet.how4: Reload your website — the chat box appears in the bottom right corner.
